## Purpose
`/settings`: the platform Settings page (1105 lines). Its sections are Overview, AI models, Tool Service, Platform, Process knowledge, Tool safety, Vault & prerequisites, Frontend & design, and Cleanup. It has search, save, reset, and model-catalog refresh and review.

## Responsibilities
- **`SettingsPage`:**
  - reads `settingsApi.get` and `catalog`;
  - saves with `update` ("Saved N setting(s)");
  - `reset`, including "Reset every setting to default" behind an alert dialog;
  - `refreshModels` ("Model list refreshed — N models");
  - the model review suggests replacements ("<label> set to <replacement> — save to apply").
- **Page parts:** StatusStrip, Overview (Kpi cards), Panel and SectionCard.
- **Section panels:** `SettingControls` (generic, typed controls), `ModelPanels`, `ProcessTemplatesPanel`, `ToolSafetyPanel`, `VaultPanel` and `CleanupPanel`.
- **Model:** `settingsModel`.
- **Keyboard:** "/" focuses the search; Escape clears it.

## Key elements
`SettingsPage`.

## Control flow
React Query and local edit state.

## Data, state and side effects
- Platform settings in the backend's runtime overrides.
- The Tool Service settings (proxied).

## Configuration
Everything on the page.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/settings`, `/api/safety-rules`, `/api/vault`, `/api/processes/templates` and `/api/settings/cleanup`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Validation messages come from the server.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Platform settings are changed by platform admins only,** and the API agrees. Users see the page read-only, with the root banner.

## How to rebuild this file
As described. It is a large page; copying it is the reliable route.

## Tests
None.
